shortDescription: Configure a Trusted communication between the Management Server and the managed Security Gateway.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: domains_to_process
options.description: Indicates which domains to process the commands on. It cannot be used with the details-level full, must be run from the System Domain only and with ignore-warnings true. Valid values are, CURRENT_DOMAIN, ALL_DOMAINS_ON_THIS_SERVER.

options.name: ipv4_address
options.description: IP address of the object, for establishing trust with dynamic gateways.

options.name: one_time_password
options.description: Shared password to establish SIC between the Security Management and the Security Gateway.

options.name: trust_settings
options.description: Settings for the trusted communication establishment.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
